_about: How Scout scores and filters listings. Every version of Scout reads this file. Edit the numbers, or use the tuning page (http://localhost:8787/tune) to try changes on a saved search first. Scores are clamped to 0-100.

price._help: Cheaper than your budget earns up to `max`. Full points when the stay is at least `fullAtShareUnderBudget` (0.4 = 40%) under budget; zero at the budget.

walk._help: Walk to the nearest station. Full points up to `fullWithinMin` minutes, falling to zero at your walking limit (10 min if you didn't give one).

reviewCount._help: How many reviews a place has matters more than its star rating. Each band is [at least this many reviews, points]. Multiplied when the request says reviews matter.

rating._help: Stars only count once a place has at least `minReviews` reviews: (rating - 4) x `perStarAbove4`.

reviewIssue._help: Each recurring problem in the reviews (dirt, bugs, mould, noise, not as described...).

seriousFlag._help: Serious red flags: description contradicts the title, host on site in an 'entire place', scam or safety reports.

centrality._help: London tube zones, when the request prefers central (most do). Zones 3+ get 0.

safety._help: Street crime around the station compared with the other listings in the same search (police data).

arrival._help: Late arrivals: a quicker airport-to-door trip earns up to `max`. Full points within `fullWithinMin`, losing 1 point every `losePointEveryMin` minutes after that.

rules._help: What drops a listing, and what makes it a near miss instead of a pick.
